# H6008 — the host colour channel request, docs/protocol/ble.md 8.
# Captured 2026-09-12, same host and same characteristics as color.txt.
#
# Both units answered the same five bytes, so the answer is a property of the
# firmware and not of the unit. Nobody established its layout.
# The answer does not depend on the checksum: the fourth row carries a wrong
# one and the unit answered it alike.
#
# > client -> device      < device -> client

> a5029037
< cdec505eb7

> a5029037                # repeated five times in one link, same answer
< cdec505eb7

> a5029000                # wrong checksum
< cdec505eb7

# Byte 1 must be 02. None of these was answered.
> a5009035
> a5019036
> a5039038
> a5049039
> a506903b
> a59090c5
